githubReconciliation.result: The W2 change and acceptance checkpoint were rebased onto the current GitHub main without overwriting concurrent device-access or Math work. Active runtime changes were reverified; nine newly added but unregistered Math enhancement assets were explicitly quarantined as inactive candidates.

findings.summary: Hub and subject apps used inconsistent message types, wildcard targets, incomplete trust checks and a query-task route that subjects did not hydrate.
findings.resolution: Added the shared BAUMAN_SUBJECT_BRIDGE_V1 contract, canonical/legacy compatibility, explicit target origins, source/origin/subject validation, query hydration and normalized progress ingestion.

findings.summary: The public Hub shipped a prefilled default administrator credential and stored local passwords as plaintext.
findings.resolution: Replaced the default with first-use administrator setup, salted PBKDF2-SHA-256 records with stored iteration metadata and migration of legacy local accounts after a successful login.

findings.summary: The Russian UI workflow still targeted a temporary branch instead of main.
findings.resolution: Aligned the workflow trigger to main.

findings.summary: The control service had no committed dependency lock and workflows used non-deterministic installation.
findings.resolution: Committed package-lock.json and changed control-service CI installs to npm ci.

findings.summary: The Math link validator treated manifest data-file strings as objects and could not validate the active package.
findings.resolution: Updated path resolution for the active data contract and verified every listed file.

findings.summary: An older Math core, planning bridge and E236-E238 audit scripts remain in the repository but are not active runtime dependencies.
findings.resolution: Documented the inactive files in subjects/math/LEGACY_QUARANTINE.md and added static assertions that they are not loaded.

findings.summary: The current application does not register a service worker.
findings.resolution: No new PWA architecture was invented; the existing device-session offline-grace behavior was retained and browser-verified.

findings.summary: Nine Math enhancement assets added concurrently through 3dff93a were present on main but not referenced by the active Math entry point.
findings.resolution: Recorded them as inactive candidates in subjects/math/LEGACY_QUARANTINE.md and made the whole-system validator enforce that they remain outside the accepted runtime until separately registered and browser-verified.

findings.summary: GitHub retains merged historical branches and several unmerged work branches, including fix/control-registry-automation.
findings.resolution: main remains the only runtime authority. Remote branches were not deleted because deletion is not required for runtime correctness and could discard independent work.
